items.title: Veterinary Pharmaceutical Submissions in the EU
items.price: EUR 1,819 (GBP 1,299), full price EUR 2,099; early booking offer until 22 Feb 2027
items.why: This is the core course on EU veterinary submissions and procedures, and booking before February gets the lower price for your regulatory affairs goal.

items.title: Advanced Veterinary Pharmacovigilance
items.price: EUR 1,819 (GBP 1,299), full price EUR 2,099; early booking offer until 15 Feb 2027
items.why: It covers Regulation 2019/6 and veterinary good pharmacovigilance practice and counts towards QPPV training, which builds your pharmacovigilance second competence.

items.title: A Practical Approach to Veterinary Vaccine Development and Registration in the EU
items.price: EUR 1,819 (GBP 1,299), full price EUR 2,099; early booking offer until 15 Dec 2026
items.why: Immunologicals are a distinct part of EU veterinary authorisation, and this spring course adds that dossier knowledge to your regulatory affairs profile.

items.title: A Practical Approach to Developing the CMC Package for Veterinary Pharmaceutical Products
items.price: EUR 909 (GBP 649), full price EUR 1,049; early booking offer until 11 Feb 2027
items.why: A one day, low cost course on the quality part of a veterinary dossier, which senior regulatory roles expect you to review confidently.

items.title: Deutsch C1.1 Intensivkurs
items.location: Hamburg (Barmbek), VHS-Zentrum Deutsch als Fremdsprache Nord
items.why: It starts next month in Hamburg with weekday morning classes and leads towards the Goethe C1 certificate, so it is an affordable first step to C1 by summer 2027.
